home.heroImageAlt: Professor Diogenes in a study room with books and a chalkboard

preview.heading: A simple route into Computer Science study
preview.body: Students begin with a short professor introduction, compare curated study tracks, open focused topic pages, and use accessibility guidance whenever they need help moving through the platform.

tracks.heading: Choose a small, curated study path
tracks.intro: Each track gives a beginner-friendly purpose and a short set of topics to inspect. Start with the track that best matches the study problem in front of you.

accessibility.heading: Navigate the foundation independently
accessibility.intro: This page explains how to move through Legado de Diogenes with a keyboard, screen reader, light or dark theme, and optional high contrast while keeping the same learning content available to every student.

light.label: Light theme
light.purpose: Balanced color-safe reading for normal presentation use

light-high.label: Light high contrast
light-high.purpose: Light surfaces with stronger borders, focus indicators, and action contrast

dark.label: Dark theme
dark.purpose: Darker reading surfaces while preserving the same content and navigation

dark-high.label: Dark high contrast
dark-high.purpose: Dark surfaces with maximum separation for text, controls, and focus states

shell.heading: Personalized learning paths
shell.intro: Review saved paths, build a focused sequence of topics, and return to learning sections without creating an account.

history.heading: Learning Path History
history.unavailable: History is temporarily unavailable. You can still open the builder and try again.
history.empty: No saved learning paths are available yet. Build a small path from the curated tracks, save it, and return here to review progress.

builder.heading: Learning Path Builder
builder.intro: Select tracks and topics to build a personal study sequence.
builder.emptyCurrentPath: Select at least one topic from the available tracks to begin building.
builder.itemRemoved: Item removed from your current path.
builder.trackAdded: {track} was added to your current path.
builder.trackRemoved: {track} was removed from your current path.
builder.topicAdded: {topic} was added to your current path.
builder.topicRemoved: {topic} was removed from your current path.
builder.cleared: Builder selections cleared. Saved paths are unchanged until Save.
builder.topicAlreadyFirst: This topic is already first in its track.
builder.topicAlreadyLast: This topic is already last in its track.
builder.topicOrderUpdated: Topic order updated inside its track.

dialogs.discardEditDescription: This returns the builder to the last saved learning path. Unsaved changes will be lost.
dialogs.discardCreateDescription: This returns the builder to an empty learning path. Unsaved selections will be lost.
dialogs.clearDescription: This clears only the builder selections on this page. Saved paths and progress stay unchanged unless you save a new composition.

loadMessages.notFound: This saved learning path could not be found. A new empty builder is ready.
loadMessages.completed: Completed learning paths are kept in history and cannot be edited.
